scope: Node actual generator and isolated voxel-change owner; no game/page storage or physics integration

checks.name: signed chunk/local identity and integer physical surface candidate
full decoded chunk bytes independent of neighboring request order
fixed map sample work across different physical extents
worker helper cancellation stops before next row batch
baseline cache mutation is discarded: no durable-edit API exists
excavation under intact surface and across signed chunk seam
batch conflicts and stale revisions never partly change terrain
actual decoded voxel eviction, regeneration and durable file reload
world, source recipe and unit mismatches reject restore
no-op and return-to-base keep only real sparse differences

baselineGap: Mutating a returned render/cache buffer is lost on eviction; no canonical edit record.

geometry.scope: proposed study geometry; no migration of existing logical levels

limitations: No page/IndexedDB save, failed-write recovery or stale async worker-result proof.
Two-soil-layer surface extrusion is a base ownership reference, not a cave/biome/drainage generator.
Changes persist only when the host writes the checkpoint; in-memory edit is not a durable receipt.
No actor, support, water-volume, gas-volume, physical feature tombstone or live-world integration.
Map count comes from inspected bounded sampler; it is not a target-browser capacity benchmark.
